CheckTitle: Security Groups with all ports open to the internet
Description: Security Groups have been found to allow access from the internet to all ports.
Risk: Exposing all ports (0-65535) to the internet allows any service to be targeted, creating an extremely high-risk attack surface for unauthorized access, malware, and full resource compromise.

Recommendation.Text: Make sure security groups do not allow any access from the internet to ports, unless required as per business requirements.
